label: View
description: Creates an HTML/PHP view file and action hook. Connect a Route to scope it, or leave it unconnected for global/custom-hook use It can also own a separate browser-side JavaScript Flow.

properties.name: hook_name
properties.label: Hook name
properties.help: Select a standard framework hook or type any custom hook name.

properties.name: priority
properties.label: Fallback priority
properties.help: Used directly for unscoped hooks. When connected to a Route, top-to-bottom order generates route-specific priorities.

properties.name: content
properties.label: HTML / PHP
properties.help: Use <tvi-component name="component-name" /> to place visual components. Template syntax supports variables, dot paths, PHP constants such as {{ ROOT }}, raw values, if blocks and foreach blocks.
